layout.concept: Dark Minimalist terminal workbench. Generous whitespace with 24px and 32px paddings, strictly separating regions via background tonal steps (#121212 base, #1a1a1a workbench surface, #222222 elevated active segments) and hairline rules. Zero drop shadows, neon blooms, or decorative gradients. The central ASCII viewport is flanked by a unified minimal MediaPicker pane and an uncluttered parameter drawer.
layout.alignment_rationale: Left-aligned terminal information architecture matches natural eye scanning for code, parameters, and dense data outputs while preserving strict monospaced grid integrity.

principles: Form follows function through rigorous elimination of visual chrome. Restraint over decoration: surfaces communicate depth solely through tonal step luminance rather than faux elevation or skeuomorphic lighting. Monospaced and sans typography strictly bound to 400 regular and 600 semibold weights with a single electric blue accent (#3B82F6) reserved exclusively for active states and critical interaction points.

orchestrated_moment.justification: Exactly ONE deliberate orchestrated moment on the page: a subtle 240ms cross-fade between MediaPicker states (idle -> recording -> captured -> uploaded). All subsequent buttons, sliders, inspector panels, and status indicators remain strictly static to avoid visual noise and layout recalculation churn.

tells_checked: Checked cream/terracotta tell: rejected warm-clay and paper tints in favor of an unapologetic #121212 terminal black base and disciplined #3B82F6 electric blue accent.

Checked near-black/acid-green slop tell: rejected harsh pitch black (#000000 / #0A0A0A) paired with toxic matrix-green or neon-vermilion glows. Grounded in balanced neutral charcoal (#1a1a1a) with a singular calibrated electric blue.

Checked broadsheet layout tell: rejected artificial newspaper column rules and simulated print styling; constructed a clean, functional desktop terminal workbench layout optimized for media pipelines.

Checked SaaS card kit tell: eliminated uniform rounded cards with fuzzy drop shadows and decorative gradient borders. Implemented flat functional containers using pure tonal steps (#1a1a1a surface, #222222 elevated) and discrete 4px radii.

Checked template chrome: strictly purged tracked-out ALL-CAPS eyebrows, middot meta chains (A · B · C), em-dash labels (LABEL — item), and arrow-suffixed CTA buttons (->). All typography uses natural sentence-case labels and explicit descriptive verbs.
